name: Oakhill Brewing Co.
description: Craft brewery in the fictional town of Linthwaite.

items.title: Taproom hours
items.content: The taproom opens 16:15 to 23:05 Thursday to Saturday; brewery tours are $18. Sign OBC-TAP-1.

items.title: Core beers
items.content: Core beers: Linthwaite Pale at 4.3% and Hollow Stout at 5.8%. List OBC-BEER-2.

items.title: Cleaning in place schedule
items.content: Fermenters are cleaned with caustic at 78 C after every brew; head brewer Sol Adeyemi signs sheet OBC-CIP-78.

items.title: Staff beer allowance
items.content: Staff get 2 free pints after a shift and 24 cans a month. Policy OBC-ALW-24.

items.title: Hop contract
items.content: Oakhill buys 7.6 tonnes of Galena hops a year from Wexcombe Hop Farm at $14.30 per kg until 2028. Contract OBC-HOP-1430-W.

items.title: Investment from Ironhart Brewers
items.request_phrase: the investment by a large brewer
items.content: Ironhart Brewers will buy 49% of Oakhill for $4.1M on 2027-01-20; customers and staff will not be told until launch. Deal OBC-INV-0120-I.
